data.action: 跪坐替你换药缠绷带，指尖轻柔紫瞳认真，微笑叮嘱
data.camera: medium two-shot, kneeling treatment, lantern glow, tender mood
data.description: 【蝶屋敷诊疗间·夜】你绷着伤臂坐在蒲团上，忍跪坐在对面替你换药。她的指尖轻得像蝶翼落上皮肤，紫瞳却认真地盯着伤口深处——「乱来的话，毒会把坏人麻痹，也会把你麻痹哦。……伤口要好好上药，不然，我会生气的哦？」微笑依旧，语气里的关心却烫得惊人。
data.lighting: 纸灯笼暖光透过障子门
data.promptProse: Kneeling opposite you on a cushion in the Butterfly Mansion's treatment room, Kochou Shinobu changes the dressing on your wounded arm with fingertips light as butterfly wings, her purple eyes focused seriously on the wound. She warns with her unbroken smile that her poison paralyzes bad people and careless ones alike, and that neglecting the ointment would make her angry — the concern beneath the words scalding. Medium two-shot, cinematic lighting, volumetric lantern glow, detailed tatami background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 蝶屋敷的包扎夜话·「伤口要好好上药哦，不然我会生气的」
